The '''''Munificent''-class star frigate''',<ref name="ROTSICS" /> commonly referred to as the '''Banking Clan frigate'''<ref name="Databank">{{DB|starship|bankingclanfrigate|Banking Clan communications frigate}}</ref> or the '''Banking Clan comms ship''',<ref name="SW:BFII" /> was a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] used by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] and by extension the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="ROTSICS" />

==Characteristics==
===Dimensions===
[[File:BankingClanFrigate-WSMI.png|thumb|left|250px|Profile view of a ''Munificent''-class frigate]]

The ''Munificent''-class was 825 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length and had a skeletal look, owing to the fact that these ships required a small crew to operate and were not designed to be [[Carrier/Legends|carriers]]. Along the longitudinal spines of the ship ran [[Tensor field/Legends|tensor fields]] and the [[Acceleration compensator/Legends|inertial compensator]] that helped maintain the structural integrity of the vessel.<ref name="ROTSICS" />

They had four extensive [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] and [[Communications array/Legends|communications arrays]] affixed to the center of the hull in a cross-pattern. Several docking rings were located underneath these and the vertical arrays also had room for several [[Point-defense laser cannon/Legends|point-defense cannons]].<ref name="ROTSICS" />

===Offensive and defensive systems===
Banking Clan [[Frigate/Legends|star frigates]] were light [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]] armed for heavy combat with oversized guns, a massive twin [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannon, and two long-range [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] for use against [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]].<ref name="ROTSICS" />

[[File:MunificentAft-USWNE.png|thumb|250px|left|Aft view of a ''Munificent''-class frigate]]
Complementing the heavy weaponry were 38 point-defense [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] for anti-[[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] firepower, and 26 twin turbolaser cannons and 20 light turbolaser turrets for flexible response.<ref name="ROTSICS" />

The twin turbolaser cannon was powerful enough to melt an ice [[Moon/Legends|moon]] measuring 1,000 km in diameter or pierce the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] of a 10 km-wide [[Grade III battle station/Legends|Grade III battle station]].<ref name="ROTSICS" />

Five ''Munificents'' were unable to stop the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] when it was trying to [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|rescue]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]].<ref name="Cargo of Doom">{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}}</ref>

The ship had high-performance sensors with a range of several light-days positioned on the dorsal side of the ship. A forward scanner was situated on top of the vessel's command tower. These sensors were top-of-the-line, able to even sense mass due to a mid-war refit following [[Trench|Admiral Trench's]] first encounter with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="ROTSICS" />

===Complement===
[[File:B1-you-said-we-would-be-safe.png|thumb|left|250px|B1 battle droids in the hallway of a frigate]]
Each ship of the class was capable of carrying 150,000 [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] for boarding or ground operations, and were capable of shielding [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] within their hulls. A system of docking rings lined the sides of each ship. In the forward hollow areas, war materials could be stored for transfer, while in [[Time/Legends|times]] of peace, they were used to transfer valuable financial assets.<ref name="ROTSICS" />

In order to compensate for its lack of a hangar, it instead transported up to four squadrons of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid star fighters]]. These ships were also heavily shielded and could withstand significant firepower until destruction. However, its hollow hull was highly vulnerable to Republic attacks if its shields failed.

===Propulsion systems===
The class was powered by twin reactors, placed side by side towards the middle of the craft. One reactor was enough to power the ship in an emergency. The two reactors together annihilated up to 2,300 tons of fuel per second. The ''Munificent''{{'s}} superdense reactant tanks were positioned at the ventral side of the ship, underneath the reactors. A series of power feeds ran from the reactors out to the various antennas and sensor systems, where power cells were stored.<ref name="ROTSICS" />

===Bridge tower===
[[File:Munificentbridge.png|thumb|left|250px|A ''Munificent''-class's bridge.]]
The command tower on a ''Munificent''-class ship was located at the bow, rising diagonally from the superstructure. The tower contained a turbolift shaft that connected the various stations. Wide panorama windows were located on each level, providing good view of the surrounding area.<ref name="ROTSICS" />

The bridge itself was sparsely equipped with a few terminals on multiple levels, rising up like a pyramid. The ship commander stood at the top, with one operator on each side.<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Separatists_over_Cato_Neimoidia.png|thumb|right|250px|Several frigates over [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] during the Clone Wars]]
Manufactured by [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc./Legends|Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc.]] and [[Gwori Revolutionary Industries/Legends|Gwori Revolutionary Industries]], the star frigates were used by the Banking Clan to defend their private, secure comm network, harass [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] heavily in debt, transfer key financial assets, and guard treasure vaults. The ''Munificent''-class acted as a key component of the Banking Clan's network by carrying [[Hyperwave transceiver/Legends|hyperwave transceivers]] and communications arrays that allowed secure financial transactions to occur across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="ROTSICS" />

When the Banking Clan joined the Confederacy, [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] devoted a fleet of star frigates to the cause. The class became a staple of the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and formed the backbone of the fleet,<ref name="TCW:TVG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> with tens of thousands produced. The ships' hulls bore the blue-and-white Confederate emblem and paint scheme, although many ships also bore both the green stripes of the Banking Clan and the Confederate colors. Towards the end of the war, thousands of ''Munificent''-class frigates participated in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].<ref name="ROTSICS" />

[[File:ROTS-Frigate.png|thumb|left|300px|One of the thousands of Munificents that took part in the Battle of Coruscant]]
''Munificent''-class star frigates assisted the navigation and coordination of Confederacy fleets deep in enemy space. They also escorted and coordinated Separatist fleet actions such as attacks on the interstellar [[HoloNet relay/Legends|HoloNet relays]] to demoralize and isolate [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces. The Confederacy also took advantage of the star frigate's powerful antennae to broadcast anti-Republic propaganda while using its jamming devices to hinder enemy sensors, targeting systems and distress calls. During the war, most, if not all, were called in for refit after Admiral Trench was defeated by a cloaked vessel, strengthening their sensors to the level of even mass detection.<ref name="ROTSICS" />

After the Clone Wars ended, many crews took their ''Munificent''s past the reaches of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], becoming pirates and mercenaries. Some vessels later ended up in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], where many ships were extensively modified to the point where they barely resembled their original design.<ref name="SOTGSE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The official [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry on the frigate indicates that the organic, rounded appearance [https://web.archive.org/web/20090226055139/http://www.starwars.com/databank/starship/bankingclanfrigate/img/bts_bg.jpg] for the starship was meant to provide a stark opposite to the clean, triangular designs of Galactic Republic and Imperial starships, instead being more similar to the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] cruisers participating in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

In the young readers adaptation ''[[The Clone Wars: Grievous Attacks!]]'', the starships are erroneously identified as freighters in the [[Mission to suspected Confederate space|Mission to sweep outer corridor of space]] chapter.

It should also be noted that the warship's depiction in ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'' is fairly different from that seen in the film; specifically, it is much simpler in design and somewhat truncated in appearance. Also, in ''Battlefront II'', the ship is called 'Banking Clan Comms Ship'.
